data.preprocessing_caveat: historical global preprocessing and pre-CV RFE; not strict unbiased population estimation

cv.checkpoint_selection: historical val_idx=test_idx; first strict higher ACC; wait>200

base_protocol.aloss: computed by original GFR but excluded from simple-2 total loss

dpa.sender_set: outer-train only; receiver != sender for train receivers; test receivers read outer-train only
dpa.lambda_schedule: 0 epochs 0-44; linear epochs 45-89; max from epoch 90
dpa.pcgrad_scope: new graph evidence parameters only; domain discriminators normal minimization

formal_tasks: 8 groups x 10 folds = 80; E0 may reuse verified Experiment43.1 best checkpoints only after independent readback

go.GO_GRAPH: E2-E1 ACC and Hard-AUC mean >= +0.1pp, each >=7/10 strict wins, independent neighbor dependency nonzero
go.GO_SELECTIVE_ALIGNMENT: E4 has measurable positive comparison against E3 and/or E2; otherwise state limitation
go.GO_GRADIENT_PROTECTION: E5-E4 positive and nonzero conflict/projection trajectory
go.GO_FINAL_MICCAI_CANDIDATE: E5 beats E0, E1, E6, E7 on both main metrics, >=7/10 strict wins, mechanisms nontrivial

audit_constraints.no_gfr_training: only original B0-B path plus isolated evidence branch
